name: shopapgo-commerce
description: APGO storefront and Airwallex order service, imported from October 1 commerce commits

scripts.test: npm run test:static && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:static: node --test tests/commerce-unit.test.mjs tests/commerce-backend.test.mjs tests/commerce-pricing.test.mjs tests/commerce-wallets.test.mjs tests/commerce-express.test.mjs tests/commerce-mcf.test.mjs tests/policy-pages.test.mjs tests/staging.test.mjs tests/hosts.test.mjs tests/site-links.test.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 execute apgo-us-store-staging --env staging --remote --file worker/schema.sql
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run db:migrate:staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
